edges.notes: KubeVirt runs VM workloads on Linux Kubernetes nodes using KVM/QEMU-class stacks per upstream documentation.
KubeVirt extends Kubernetes with VM CRDs and controllers; Kubernetes is the orchestration plane, KubeVirt is the VM workload extension.
Node components commonly compose libvirt/QEMU/KVM paths as described in KubeVirt architecture materials (survey-level; cite release-specific docs per claim).
Guest execution uses QEMU on nodes in typical Linux deployments; QEMU is the VMM, KubeVirt is the Kubernetes integration layer.
KVM backs QEMU on Linux nodes for hardware-accelerated virtualization; KVM is the kernel API, KubeVirt orchestrates via Kubernetes.
